newsitem.title: FRANCE: Delivery sought on October sugar - MATIF.
newsitem.headline: Delivery sought on October sugar - MATIF.

text.p: Operators sought physical delivery on all 100 positions outstanding on the now expired October sugar contract, French futures exchange MATIF said on Monday.
"Physical delivery was requested on all 100 lots," a MATIF spokewoman said.
The October contract expired on September 13.
The lots translate into 5,000 tonnes of sugar on the physical market.
The spokeswoman said the sugar was priced at $340 per tonne and the port of delivery chosen was Gdansk in Poland. The seller was Credit Agricole and the buyer Commerciale DWD.
